description: The harness's blocking question tool refused in a repository under the verstak cover; onboarding invitation at session start in a repository not yet aligned for the agent; the role's way back after a context compaction; the session rituals — start, push, merge — by the repository's cover; at a turn's end, a frame's turn that left its word in the console is woken once

Ask in words someone answering now; a question that outlives the turn goes into the case as an ask card (verstak_case, action ask).'}};eval('const COVER_FILE=\x22AGENTS.md\x22;const COVER_ROOT=\x22verstak\x22;const FLAT_KEYS=[\x22Graph\x22,\x22Agent role\x22];const OWN_STAMPS=[/\x5c((?:verstak align:\x5cs*contract\x5cs*\x60?(\x5cd+)\x60?\x5cs*,\x5cs*stamped|verstakify:\x5cs*contract\x5cb)/];const OTHER_STAMP=/^[\x5cs*_]*\x5c((?!verstak align:|verstakify:)[^()\x5cn]*?:\x5cs*(?:contract|\x5cu043a\x5cu043e\x5cu043d\x5cu0442\x5cu0440\x5cu0430\x5cu043a\x5cu0442)\x5cs*\x60?\x5cd+/m;\x0alet input = \x22\x22;\x0aprocess.stdin\x0a  .on(\x22data\x22, (chunk) => (input += chunk))\x0a  .on(\x22end\x22, () => {\x0a    const fs = require(\x22fs\x22),\x0a      path = require(\x22path\x22);\x0a    const read = (file) => {\x0a      try {\x0a        return fs.readFileSync(file, \x22utf8\x22);\x0a      } catch {\x0a        return null;\x0a      }\x0a    };\x0a    const exists = (file) => {\x0a      try {\x0a        fs.statSync(file);\x0a        return true;\x0a      } catch {\x0a        return false;\x0a      }\x0a    };\x0a    let root = process.cwd();\x0a    try {\x0a      const event = JSON.parse(input);\x0a      if (typeof event.cwd === \x22string\x22 && event.cwd) root = event.cwd;\x0a    } catch {}\x0a    for (root = path.resolve(root); !exists(path.join(root, \x22.git\x22));) {\x0a      const up = path.dirname(root);\x0a      if (up === root) return;\x0a      root = up;\x0a    }\x0a    const unquote = (v) => {\x0a      const s = v.trim();\x0a      if (s.length >= 2 && s[0] === \x22\x27\x22 && s.endsWith(\x22\x27\x22))\x0a        return s.slice(1, -1).replace(/\x27\x27/g, \x22\x27\x22);\x0a      if (s.length >= 2 && s[0] === \x27\x22\x27 && s.endsWith(\x27\x22\x27)) {\x0a        try {\x0a          return String(JSON.parse(s));\x0a        } catch {\x0a          return s.slice(1, -1);\x0a        }\x0a      }\x0a      return s;\x0a    };\x0a    const KEY = String.raw\x60(\x27(?:[^\x27]|\x27\x27)*\x27|\x22(?:[^\x22\x5c\x5c]|\x5c\x5c.)*\x22|[^\x5cs\x27\x22#][^:]*?)\x60;\x0a    const PAIR = new RegExp(String.raw\x60^\x5cs*\x24{KEY}\x5cs*:(?:\x5cs+(.*))?\x24\x60);\x0a    const TOP = new RegExp(String.raw\x60^\x24{KEY}\x5cs*:(?:\x5cs+#.*)?\x5cs*\x24\x60);\x0a    const CHILD = new RegExp(String.raw\x60^\x5cs+\x24{KEY}\x5cs*:(?:\x5cs+(.*))?\x24\x60);\x0a    const bare = (v) =>\x0a      unquote(\x0a        /^[\x27\x22]/.test(v.trim())\x0a          ? v.trim().replace(/^(\x27(?:[^\x27]|\x27\x27)*\x27|\x22(?:[^\x22\x5c\x5c]|\x5c\x5c.)*\x22)\x5cs+#.*\x24/, \x22\x241\x22)\x0a          : v.replace(/\x5cs+#.*\x24/, \x22\x22),\x0a      );\x0a    const frontLines = (text) => {\x0a      const lines = text.replace(/^\x5cuFEFF/, \x22\x22).split(/\x5cr?\x5cn/);\x0a      if (lines[0]?.trim() !== \x22---\x22) return null;\x0a      const end = lines.findIndex((l, i) => i > 0 && l.trim() === \x22---\x22);\x0a      return end < 0 ? null : lines.slice(1, end);\x0a    };\x0a    const blocks = (text) => {\x0a      const out = new Map();\x0a      let open = null;\x0a      for (const line of frontLines(text) ?? []) {\x0a        if (/^\x5cs*(#|\x24)/.test(line)) continue;\x0a        const top = TOP.exec(line),\x0a          child = open && CHILD.exec(line);\x0a        if (top) out.set(unquote(top[1]), (open = new Map()));\x0a        else if (open && child) open.set(unquote(child[1]), bare(child[2] ?? \x22\x22));\x0a        else open = null;\x0a      }\x0a      return out;\x0a    };\x0a    const pairs = (text) => {\x0a      const lines = frontLines(text);\x0a      if (!lines) return null;\x0a      const out = new Map();\x0a      let last = null;\x0a      for (const line of lines) {\x0a        const kv = PAIR.exec(line);\x0a        if (kv) out.set((last = unquote(kv[1])), kv[2] ?? \x22\x22);\x0a        else if (last !== null && /^\x5cs+[^\x5cs#]/.test(line))\x0a          out.set(last, out.get(last) + \x22\x5cn\x22 + line.trim());\x0a      }\x0a      return out;\x0a    };\x0a    const text = read(path.join(root, COVER_FILE));\x0a    let cover = false,\x0a      stamp = false;\x0a    if (text !== null) {\x0a      const all = blocks(text),\x0a        block = all.get(COVER_ROOT);\x0a      const own =\x0a        (block && /^\x5cd+\x24/.test(block.get(\x22contract\x22) ?? \x22\x22) && !!block.get(\x22stamp\x22)) ||\x0a        OWN_STAMPS.some((re) => re.test(text));\x0a      const foreign =\x0a        !own &&\x0a        !block &&\x0a        ([...all].some(([k, b]) => k !== COVER_ROOT && b.has(\x22contract\x22)) ||\x0a          OTHER_STAMP.test(text));\x0a      stamp = !!own;\x0a      const flat = pairs(text);\x0a      cover = !foreign && (!!block || (!!flat && FLAT_KEYS.some((k) => flat.has(k))));\x0a    }\x0a    if (!(cover || stamp)) return;\x0a    process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(DENY));\x0a  });\x0a')"
